sourceImage.meaning: 左右にStandard Container NetworkingとCilium eBPF Container Networking。両側PodはProcess/Socket/iptables INPUT/Linux Routing/iptables PREROUTING mangle/iptables Conntrack/veth。左ホストはFORWARD/POSTROUTING mangle・nat/PREROUTING nat・mangle/Conntrack/Linux Routing/eth0でiptablesとConntrack・veth Context-Switch Overheadを赤注記。右はホストiptables/conntrack灰色、eth0からeBPF Host Routingを介したveth接続、Linux Routingへの破線。右のPod内iptablesは残存。
